author: FXTD Studios Research, 2 Nov 2026, before any run of this arm
purpose: The 0 EV arm (training/aces_partial_tighten.py, 2 Nov 2026): after the shipped constraint, partially clipped support pixels more than half a code from the source move toward the analytic baseline until within it. 'bisect' (primary): the largest blend in [0,1] by bisection, the hypothesis being that a continuous blend keeps the aligned-residual motion gate that 25 Oct's discrete halving broke. 'halving': that 25 Oct method on d6400, the control. Registered before any run. Original limits. No release qualification.
decision_rule: tighten_bisect is a release candidate only if ALL hold: (1) fresh set: grade_0 as RMS codes <= analytic RMS + 0.1 code (the 25 Oct agreed rule), grade -3 and +3 and H no worse than the analytic inverse; (2) development: every paired gate of the original registration including aligned residual <= .010367, original grade limits (-3 <= 18.62, 0 <= .06038, +3 <= .00250); (3) Hunyuan48 flicker <= .020 EV and all video checks; (4) no new negative Y. Then a confirmatory run on a new holdout (docs/competitive/HOLDOUT_KIT.md). halving is reported as the control, never selected.
honesty: The fresh v2 set and the development sets have all been looked at; every result here is development evidence.
limits: The rebuilt fresh set differs from the registered one in 8 of 42 sources (rounding); see RESULT_FULL_ONLY_ROUTE_2026_11_02.md.
